e|how was your weekend.name: how was your weekend
e|how was your weekend.why: 지난 주말을 묻는 말은 과거형 was를 써서 how was your weekend예요.

e|it was fun.name: it was fun
e|it was fun.why: 과거에 재미있었다는 평은 it was fun이에요.
e|it was fun.line: We played outside and it was fun.

e|not bad at all.name: not bad at all
e|not bad at all.why: 전혀 나쁘지 않다는 뜻으로 not bad 뒤에 at all을 붙이면 not bad at all이에요.
e|not bad at all.line: Your drawing is not bad at all.

e|what are you up to.name: what are you up to
e|what are you up to.gloss: 안녕, 이번 주말에 뭐 할 거야?
e|what are you up to.why: 지금 뭐 하는지 물을 때는 what are you up to예요.
e|what are you up to.line: Hi, what are you up to this weekend?

e|are you free on.name: are you free on
e|are you free on.why: 요일에 시간이 있는지 물을 때는 요일 앞에 on을 둔 are you free on이에요.
e|are you free on.line: Hi, are you free on Friday night?

e|sounds good.name: sounds good
e|sounds good.gloss: 다섯 시에 공원에서 만나는 거 좋아요.
e|sounds good.before: We can meet at the park at five,
e|sounds good.why: 그 제안이 좋다는 대답은 sounds good이에요.
e|sounds good.line: We can meet at the park at five, sounds good.

e|let's meet at.name: let's meet at
e|let's meet at.why: 만날 장소를 제안할 때는 Let's meet at 뒤에 장소를 둬요.
e|let's meet at.line: Let's meet at the park after school.

e|see you then.name: see you then
e|see you then.gloss: 영화가 일곱 시에 시작하니까 그때 보자.
e|see you then.why: 정해 둔 그 시각에 보자고 할 때는 see you then이에요.
e|see you then.line: The movie starts at seven, see you then.

e|maybe next time.name: maybe next time
e|maybe next time.gloss: 미안해, 다음에 같이 놀 수 있을 거야.
e|maybe next time.why: 이번은 어렵고 다음을 기약할 때는 maybe next time이에요.
e|maybe next time.line: Sorry, maybe next time we can play together.

e|a bit expensive.name: a bit expensive
e|a bit expensive.gloss: 이 셔츠는 내가 내고 싶은 것보다 좀 비싸요.
e|a bit expensive.why: 조금 비싸다는 정도는 a bit expensive예요.
e|a bit expensive.line: This shirt is a bit expensive for me.

e|a little cheaper.name: a little cheaper
e|a little cheaper.gloss: 내 집세가 조금 더 쌌으면 좋겠어요.
e|a little cheaper.why: 조금 더 싸다는 비교는 a little cheaper예요.
e|a little cheaper.line: I wish my rent was a little cheaper.

e|which one is better.name: which one is better
e|which one is better.gloss: 나는 셔츠 두 개가 있어, 어떤 게 더 나아?
e|which one is better.why: 둘 중 더 나은 쪽을 물을 때는 which one is better예요.
e|which one is better.line: I have two shirts, which one is better?

e|for here or to go.name: for here or to go
e|for here or to go.why: 여기서 드실지 포장하실지 물을 때는 for here or to go예요.
e|for here or to go.line: Hi, for here or to go?

e|with oat milk.name: with oat milk
e|with oat milk.gloss: 커피에 일반 우유 대신 오트 밀크를 넣어 주세요.
e|with oat milk.why: 오트 밀크를 넣어 달라는 말은 with oat milk예요.
e|with oat milk.line: Can I get my coffee with oat milk?

e|by the way.name: by the way
e|by the way.why: 하던 말에 새 이야기를 덧붙일 때는 By the way로 시작해요.
e|by the way.line: By the way, do you have an umbrella?

e|how long does it take.name: how long does it take
e|how long does it take.gloss: 공원까지 걸어서 얼마나 걸리는지 알고 싶어요.
e|how long does it take.why: 걸리는 시간을 물을 때는 How long does it take예요.
e|how long does it take.line: How long does it take to walk to the park?

e|on the way.name: on the way
e|on the way.why: 지금 오는 중이라는 말은 on the way예요.
e|on the way.line: The pizza is on the way.

e|last night.name: last night
e|last night.before: I saw a cat in the yard
e|last night.why: 어제 밤을 가리킬 때는 last night예요.
e|last night.line: I saw a cat in the yard last night.

e|next weekend.name: next weekend
e|next weekend.gloss: 나는 다음 주말에 할머니를 볼 거예요.
e|next weekend.why: 다가오는 주말을 가리킬 때는 next weekend예요.
e|next weekend.line: I will see my grandma next weekend.

e|what happened.name: what happened
e|what happened.why: 무슨 일이 있었는지 물을 때는 과거형 What happened예요.

e|that's too bad.name: that's too bad
e|that's too bad.line: You lost your hat? That's too bad.

e|let me check.name: let me check
e|let me check.why: 내가 확인해 보겠다는 말은 Let me check예요.
e|let me check.line: Let me check if the bus is here.
